_about: Public-domain William Huntington, S.S. (1745-1813, coal-heaver turned preacher of Providence Chapel, London; not the American W. R. Huntington) for the Word Hoard: thirteen of the twenty volumes of his Works (London: E. Huntington, 1811; vols. II, III, V, VI, XV, XVII and XIX not found), Gleanings of the Vintage (1813) and Posthumous Letters vol. II (catalogued 1815), raw Internet Archive OCR (Google scans, fair). The Bank of Faith and The Kingdom of Heaven Taken by Prayer are in the Works. Added 2026-10-10 by lane A, round 17 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
